body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a point within 4 units you can reach by movement. Move there, then gain +1 Defense until your next turn. After this resolves, you may become Unstable; if you do, gain +1 additional Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: Until the end of this turn, you may climb or leap through difficult terrain without additional movement cost.
Ignore 1 Defense from concealment or cover for this Action.

rider.title: STRIDER ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Skybound Form. While maintained: You may move vertically through open space; if you end your turn unsupported, descend safely to the nearest surface.
